en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Retail Sales Associate?
en.hint: Share your background, one useful skill, and why this role feels right for you.
en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise customer service and communication. I am interested in the Retail Sales Associate role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use customer service in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes customer service visible in my daily work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you were responsible for helping a customer find the right product, or a similar task.
en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a busy shift, I was responsible for helping a customer find the right product. I checked the need, used customer service, and agreed the next steps with a teammate. We completed the task on time. Replace this with your own situation and real outcome.

en.text: As a Retail Sales Associate, how would you decide what to do first during a busy shift?
en.hint: Explain how you balance safety, urgency, and the people waiting for help.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would deal with any immediate safety issue first, then prioritise urgent tasks and people who are waiting. I would agree responsibilities with my teammate and explain any delay. I would still check accuracy before completing the work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you work it out?
en.hint: Show how you listened, found common ground, and reached a useful outcome.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a team task, we disagreed about priorities. I needed to help finish on time. I listened to my teammate, explained my concern, and suggested dividing the work. We agreed a plan and completed the task without delay. Use a real example from your life.

en.text: What would you do if you noticed a mistake involving billing?

en.text: Tell me about a time you used feedback to improve your work.
en.hint: Explain the feedback, what you changed, and how things improved.

hi.text: अपने बारे में बताइए। आप रिटेल सेल्स एसोसिएट का काम क्यों करना चाहते हैं?
hi.hint: अपना परिचय, एक उपयोगी कौशल और काम करने की वजह बताइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: मैंने अपने रोज़ के अनुभव से ग्राहक सेवा और बातचीत सीखा है। रिटेल सेल्स एसोसिएट में मैं लोगों की मदद और ज़िम्मेदारी से काम करना चाहता/चाहती हूँ। अपने असली अनुभव और रुचि के अनुसार इसे बदलिए।

hi.text: इस काम में ग्राहक सेवा को आप रोज़ कैसे अपनाएँगे?
hi.hint: एक काम का उदाहरण और दो व्यावहारिक कदम बताइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: मैं पहले सामने वाले की ज़रूरत सुनूँगा/सुनूँगी। फिर नियमों के अनुसार दो साफ़ विकल्प दूँगा/दूँगी और पूछूँगा/पूछूँगी कि अगला कदम समझ आया या नहीं। इससे ग्राहक सेवा व्यवहार में दिखता है।

hi.text: कोई समय बताइए जब आपको ग्राहक को सही सामान चुनने में मदद करना जैसी ज़िम्मेदारी मिली। आपने क्या किया?
hi.hint: स्थिति → ज़िम्मेदारी → आपका काम → नतीजा। घर या पढ़ाई का उदाहरण भी चलेगा।

hi.text: जब एक साथ कई काम हों, तो रिटेल सेल्स एसोसिएट के रूप में आप किसे पहले करेंगे?
hi.hint: सुरक्षा और ज़रूरत के अनुसार प्राथमिकता समझाइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: पहले किसी सुरक्षा जोखिम को संभालूँगा/संभालूँगी। फिर ज़रूरी काम और इंतज़ार कर रहे लोगों को प्राथमिकता दूँगा/दूँगी। साथी से मदद और देरी के बारे में स्पष्ट जानकारी दूँगा/दूँगी।

hi.text: कोई ऐसा समय बताइए जब आपकी टीम में मतभेद हुआ। आपने उसे कैसे सुलझाया?
hi.hint: बताइए कि आपने दूसरे व्यक्ति की बात कैसे सुनी और क्या समाधान निकाला।
hi.model: उदाहरण: एक टीम के काम में हमारी प्राथमिकताओं पर मतभेद था। मुझे काम समय पर पूरा करना था। मैंने साथी की बात सुनी, अपना कारण बताया और मिलकर काम बाँटा। नतीजे में काम बिना देरी पूरा हुआ। अपने अनुभव से बदलें।

hi.text: बिलिंग में गलती दिखने पर आप क्या करेंगे?
hi.hint: जांच, ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को सूचना और सुधार के कदम बताइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: बिलिंग में गलती दिखे तो पहले तथ्य जांचूँगा/जांचूँगी, सुरक्षित ढंग से काम रोकूँगा/रोकूँगी और ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को बताऊँगा/बताऊँगी। अपने अधिकार में सुधार करके आगे ऐसी गलती रोकने का तरीका तय करूँगा/करूँगी।

hi.text: एक समय बताइए जब आपने प्रतिक्रिया लेकर अपना काम बेहतर किया।
hi.hint: पहले क्या दिक्कत थी, आपने क्या बदला, और क्या बेहतर हुआ?

hi.model: उदाहरण: पहले किसी सुरक्षा जोखिम को संभालूँगा/संभालूँगी। फिर ज़रूरी काम और इंतज़ार कर रहे लोगों को प्राथमिकता दूँगा/दूँगी। साथी से मदद और देरी के बारे में स्पष्ट जानकारी दूँगा/दूँगी।

hi.text: कोई ऐसा समय बताइए जब आपकी टीम में मतभेद हुआ। आपने उसे कैसे सुलझाया?
hi.hint: बताइए कि आपने दूसरे व्यक्ति की बात कैसे सुनी और क्या समाधान निकाला।
hi.model: उदाहरण: एक टीम के काम में हमारी प्राथमिकताओं पर मतभेद था। मुझे काम समय पर पूरा करना था। मैंने साथी की बात सुनी, अपना कारण बताया और मिलकर काम बाँटा। नतीजे में काम बिना देरी पूरा हुआ। अपने अनुभव से बदलें।

hi.text: बिलिंग में गलती दिखने पर आप क्या करेंगे?

hi.hint: पहले क्या दिक्कत थी, आपने क्या बदला, और क्या बेहतर हुआ?

en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Inventory Assistant?
en.hint: Share your background, one useful skill, and why this role feels right for you.
en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise customer service and communication. I am interested in the Inventory Assistant role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use customer service in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes customer service visible in my daily work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you were responsible for helping a customer find the right product, or a similar task.
en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a busy shift, I was responsible for helping a customer find the right product. I checked the need, used customer service, and agreed the next steps with a teammate. We completed the task on time. Replace this with your own situation and real outcome.

en.text: As a Inventory Assistant, how would you decide what to do first during a busy shift?
en.hint: Explain how you balance safety, urgency, and the people waiting for help.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would deal with any immediate safety issue first, then prioritise urgent tasks and people who are waiting. I would agree responsibilities with my teammate and explain any delay. I would still check accuracy before completing the work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you work it out?
en.hint: Show how you listened, found common ground, and reached a useful outcome.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a team task, we disagreed about priorities. I needed to help finish on time. I listened to my teammate, explained my concern, and suggested dividing the work. We agreed a plan and completed the task without delay. Use a real example from your life.

en.text: What would you do if you noticed a mistake involving billing?
en.hint: Talk through checking the facts, informing the right person, and correcting it.
en.model: Example to adapt: If I noticed a mistake involving billing, I would check the facts and pause any unsafe action. I would inform the responsible person, make only corrections I am authorised to make, and agree how to prevent it happening again.

en.text: Tell me about a time you used feedback to improve your work.
en.hint: Explain the feedback, what you changed, and how things improved.
en.model: Example to adapt: A teammate told me my instructions were unclear. I needed to communicate better, so I asked for an example, broke instructions into shorter steps, and checked understanding. We had fewer repeated questions afterward. Share your own feedback, action and outcome.

en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Warehouse Picker?

hi.model: उदाहरण: मैं पहले सामने वाले की ज़रूरत सुनूँगा/सुनूँगी। फिर नियमों के अनुसार दो साफ़ विकल्प दूँगा/दूँगी और पूछूँगा/पूछूँगी कि अगला कदम समझ आया या नहीं। इससे स्थल सुरक्षा व्यवहार में दिखता है।

hi.text: कोई समय बताइए जब आपको निर्माण स्थल पर असुरक्षित स्थिति पहचानना जैसी ज़िम्मेदारी मिली। आपने क्या किया?
hi.hint: स्थिति → ज़िम्मेदारी → आपका काम → नतीजा। घर या पढ़ाई का उदाहरण भी चलेगा।
hi.model: उदाहरण: एक व्यस्त दिन में मुझे निर्माण स्थल पर असुरक्षित स्थिति पहचानना की ज़िम्मेदारी मिली। मैंने पहले ज़रूरत समझी, स्थल सुरक्षा पर ध्यान दिया और साथी से काम बाँटा। काम समय पर पूरा हुआ। अपना असली नतीजा जोड़ें।

hi.text: जब एक साथ कई काम हों, तो निर्माण पर्यवेक्षक के रूप में आप किसे पहले करेंगे?
hi.hint: सुरक्षा और ज़रूरत के अनुसार प्राथमिकता समझाइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: पहले किसी सुरक्षा जोखिम को संभालूँगा/संभालूँगी। फिर ज़रूरी काम और इंतज़ार कर रहे लोगों को प्राथमिकता दूँगा/दूँगी। साथी से मदद और देरी के बारे में स्पष्ट जानकारी दूँगा/दूँगी।

hi.text: कोई ऐसा समय बताइए जब आपकी टीम में मतभेद हुआ। आपने उसे कैसे सुलझाया?
hi.hint: बताइए कि आपने दूसरे व्यक्ति की बात कैसे सुनी और क्या समाधान निकाला।
hi.model: उदाहरण: एक टीम के काम में हमारी प्राथमिकताओं पर मतभेद था। मुझे काम समय पर पूरा करना था। मैंने साथी की बात सुनी, अपना कारण बताया और मिलकर काम बाँटा। नतीजे में काम बिना देरी पूरा हुआ। अपने अनुभव से बदलें।

hi.text: माप में गलती दिखने पर आप क्या करेंगे?
hi.hint: जांच, ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को सूचना और सुधार के कदम बताइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: माप में गलती दिखे तो पहले तथ्य जांचूँगा/जांचूँगी, सुरक्षित ढंग से काम रोकूँगा/रोकूँगी और ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को बताऊँगा/बताऊँगी। अपने अधिकार में सुधार करके आगे ऐसी गलती रोकने का तरीका तय करूँगा/करूँगी।

hi.text: एक समय बताइए जब आपने प्रतिक्रिया लेकर अपना काम बेहतर किया।
hi.hint: पहले क्या दिक्कत थी, आपने क्या बदला, और क्या बेहतर हुआ?
hi.model: उदाहरण: किसी साथी ने बताया कि मेरे निर्देश साफ़ नहीं थे। मुझे बेहतर बातचीत करनी थी। मैंने एक उदाहरण पूछा, निर्देश छोटे कदमों में दिए और समझ की पुष्टि की। इससे दोबारा पूछना कम हुआ। केवल अपना असली अनुभव बताइए।

en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Mason?
en.hint: Share your background, one useful skill, and why this role feels right for you.
en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise site safety and teamwork. I am interested in the Mason role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use site safety in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes site safety visible in my daily work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you were responsible for identifying an unsafe situation on a building site, or a similar task.
en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a busy shift, I was responsible for identifying an unsafe situation on a building site. I checked the need, used site safety, and agreed the next steps with a teammate. We completed the task on time. Replace this with your own situation and real outcome.

en.text: As a Mason, how would you decide what to do first during a busy shift?
en.hint: Explain how you balance safety, urgency, and the people waiting for help.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would deal with any immediate safety issue first, then prioritise urgent tasks and people who are waiting. I would agree responsibilities with my teammate and explain any delay. I would still check accuracy before completing the work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you work it out?
en.hint: Show how you listened, found common ground, and reached a useful outcome.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a team task, we disagreed about priorities. I needed to help finish on time. I listened to my teammate, explained my concern, and suggested dividing the work. We agreed a plan and completed the task without delay. Use a real example from your life.

en.text: What would you do if you noticed a mistake involving measurement?
en.hint: Talk through checking the facts, informing the right person, and correcting it.
en.model: Example to adapt: If I noticed a mistake involving measurement, I would check the facts and pause any unsafe action. I would inform the responsible person, make only corrections I am authorised to make, and agree how to prevent it happening again.

en.text: Tell me about a time you used feedback to improve your work.
en.hint: Explain the feedback, what you changed, and how things improved.
en.model: Example to adapt: A teammate told me my instructions were unclear. I needed to communicate better, so I asked for an example, broke instructions into shorter steps, and checked understanding. We had fewer repeated questions afterward. Share your own feedback, action and outcome.

en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Plumber?
en.hint: Share your background, one useful skill, and why this role feels right for you.
en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise site safety and teamwork. I am interested in the Plumber role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use site safety in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes site safety visible in my daily work.

en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.

hi.text: जब एक साथ कई काम हों, तो कस्टमर सपोर्ट एग्ज़ीक्यूटिव के रूप में आप किसे पहले करेंगे?
hi.hint: सुरक्षा और ज़रूरत के अनुसार प्राथमिकता समझाइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: पहले किसी सुरक्षा जोखिम को संभालूँगा/संभालूँगी। फिर ज़रूरी काम और इंतज़ार कर रहे लोगों को प्राथमिकता दूँगा/दूँगी। साथी से मदद और देरी के बारे में स्पष्ट जानकारी दूँगा/दूँगी।

hi.text: कोई ऐसा समय बताइए जब आपकी टीम में मतभेद हुआ। आपने उसे कैसे सुलझाया?
hi.hint: बताइए कि आपने दूसरे व्यक्ति की बात कैसे सुनी और क्या समाधान निकाला।
hi.model: उदाहरण: एक टीम के काम में हमारी प्राथमिकताओं पर मतभेद था। मुझे काम समय पर पूरा करना था। मैंने साथी की बात सुनी, अपना कारण बताया और मिलकर काम बाँटा। नतीजे में काम बिना देरी पूरा हुआ। अपने अनुभव से बदलें।

hi.text: कंप्यूटर ज्ञान में गलती दिखने पर आप क्या करेंगे?
hi.hint: जांच, ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को सूचना और सुधार के कदम बताइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: कंप्यूटर ज्ञान में गलती दिखे तो पहले तथ्य जांचूँगा/जांचूँगी, सुरक्षित ढंग से काम रोकूँगा/रोकूँगी और ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को बताऊँगा/बताऊँगी। अपने अधिकार में सुधार करके आगे ऐसी गलती रोकने का तरीका तय करूँगा/करूँगी।

hi.text: एक समय बताइए जब आपने प्रतिक्रिया लेकर अपना काम बेहतर किया।
hi.hint: पहले क्या दिक्कत थी, आपने क्या बदला, और क्या बेहतर हुआ?
hi.model: उदाहरण: किसी साथी ने बताया कि मेरे निर्देश साफ़ नहीं थे। मुझे बेहतर बातचीत करनी थी। मैंने एक उदाहरण पूछा, निर्देश छोटे कदमों में दिए और समझ की पुष्टि की। इससे दोबारा पूछना कम हुआ। केवल अपना असली अनुभव बताइए।

en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Telecaller?
en.hint: Share your background, one useful skill, and why this role feels right for you.
en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise active listening and communication. I am interested in the Telecaller role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use active listening in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes active listening visible in my daily work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you were responsible for resolving a caller’s concern with patience, or a similar task.
en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a busy shift, I was responsible for resolving a caller’s concern with patience. I checked the need, used active listening, and agreed the next steps with a teammate. We completed the task on time. Replace this with your own situation and real outcome.

en.text: As a Telecaller, how would you decide what to do first during a busy shift?
en.hint: Explain how you balance safety, urgency, and the people waiting for help.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would deal with any immediate safety issue first, then prioritise urgent tasks and people who are waiting. I would agree responsibilities with my teammate and explain any delay. I would still check accuracy before completing the work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you work it out?
en.hint: Show how you listened, found common ground, and reached a useful outcome.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a team task, we disagreed about priorities. I needed to help finish on time. I listened to my teammate, explained my concern, and suggested dividing the work. We agreed a plan and completed the task without delay. Use a real example from your life.

en.text: What would you do if you noticed a mistake involving computer basics?
en.hint: Talk through checking the facts, informing the right person, and correcting it.
en.model: Example to adapt: If I noticed a mistake involving computer basics, I would check the facts and pause any unsafe action. I would inform the responsible person, make only corrections I am authorised to make, and agree how to prevent it happening again.

en.text: Tell me about a time you used feedback to improve your work.
en.hint: Explain the feedback, what you changed, and how things improved.
en.model: Example to adapt: A teammate told me my instructions were unclear. I needed to communicate better, so I asked for an example, broke instructions into shorter steps, and checked understanding. We had fewer repeated questions afterward. Share your own feedback, action and outcome.

en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise active listening and communication. I am interested in the Help Desk Assistant role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use active listening in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes active listening visible in my daily work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you were responsible for resolving a caller’s concern with patience, or a similar task.
en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.

en.text: As a Help Desk Assistant, how would you decide what to do first during a busy shift?
en.hint: Explain how you balance safety, urgency, and the people waiting for help.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would deal with any immediate safety issue first, then prioritise urgent tasks and people who are waiting. I would agree responsibilities with my teammate and explain any delay. I would still check accuracy before completing the work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you work it out?
en.hint: Show how you listened, found common ground, and reached a useful outcome.

en.text: What would you do if you noticed a mistake involving computer basics?

en.hint: Explain the feedback, what you changed, and how things improved.

hi.text: अपने बारे में बताइए। आप हेल्प डेस्क सहायक का काम क्यों करना चाहते हैं?

hi.model: उदाहरण: पहले किसी सुरक्षा जोखिम को संभालूँगा/संभालूँगी। फिर ज़रूरी काम और इंतज़ार कर रहे लोगों को प्राथमिकता दूँगा/दूँगी। साथी से मदद और देरी के बारे में स्पष्ट जानकारी दूँगा/दूँगी।

hi.text: कोई ऐसा समय बताइए जब आपकी टीम में मतभेद हुआ। आपने उसे कैसे सुलझाया?
hi.hint: बताइए कि आपने दूसरे व्यक्ति की बात कैसे सुनी और क्या समाधान निकाला।
hi.model: उदाहरण: एक टीम के काम में हमारी प्राथमिकताओं पर मतभेद था। मुझे काम समय पर पूरा करना था। मैंने साथी की बात सुनी, अपना कारण बताया और मिलकर काम बाँटा। नतीजे में काम बिना देरी पूरा हुआ। अपने अनुभव से बदलें।

hi.text: टीमवर्क में गलती दिखने पर आप क्या करेंगे?
hi.hint: जांच, ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को सूचना और सुधार के कदम बताइए।
hi.model: उदाहरण: टीमवर्क में गलती दिखे तो पहले तथ्य जांचूँगा/जांचूँगी, सुरक्षित ढंग से काम रोकूँगा/रोकूँगी और ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति को बताऊँगा/बताऊँगी। अपने अधिकार में सुधार करके आगे ऐसी गलती रोकने का तरीका तय करूँगा/करूँगी।

hi.text: एक समय बताइए जब आपने प्रतिक्रिया लेकर अपना काम बेहतर किया।
hi.hint: पहले क्या दिक्कत थी, आपने क्या बदला, और क्या बेहतर हुआ?

en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Food & Beverage Server?
en.hint: Share your background, one useful skill, and why this role feels right for you.
en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise customer service and hygiene. I am interested in the Food & Beverage Server role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use customer service in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes customer service visible in my daily work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you were responsible for welcoming a guest during a busy shift, or a similar task.
en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a busy shift, I was responsible for welcoming a guest during a busy shift. I checked the need, used customer service, and agreed the next steps with a teammate. We completed the task on time. Replace this with your own situation and real outcome.

en.text: As a Food & Beverage Server, how would you decide what to do first during a busy shift?
en.hint: Explain how you balance safety, urgency, and the people waiting for help.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would deal with any immediate safety issue first, then prioritise urgent tasks and people who are waiting. I would agree responsibilities with my teammate and explain any delay. I would still check accuracy before completing the work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you work it out?
en.hint: Show how you listened, found common ground, and reached a useful outcome.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a team task, we disagreed about priorities. I needed to help finish on time. I listened to my teammate, explained my concern, and suggested dividing the work. We agreed a plan and completed the task without delay. Use a real example from your life.

en.text: What would you do if you noticed a mistake involving teamwork?
en.hint: Talk through checking the facts, informing the right person, and correcting it.
en.model: Example to adapt: If I noticed a mistake involving teamwork, I would check the facts and pause any unsafe action. I would inform the responsible person, make only corrections I am authorised to make, and agree how to prevent it happening again.

en.text: Tell me about a time you used feedback to improve your work.
en.hint: Explain the feedback, what you changed, and how things improved.
en.model: Example to adapt: A teammate told me my instructions were unclear. I needed to communicate better, so I asked for an example, broke instructions into shorter steps, and checked understanding. We had fewer repeated questions afterward. Share your own feedback, action and outcome.

hi.text: टीमवर्क में गलती दिखने पर आप क्या करेंगे?

hi.text: एक समय बताइए जब आपने प्रतिक्रिया लेकर अपना काम बेहतर किया।
hi.hint: पहले क्या दिक्कत थी, आपने क्या बदला, और क्या बेहतर हुआ?

en.text: Tell me a little about yourself. What interests you in becoming a Assembly Line Worker?
en.hint: Share your background, one useful skill, and why this role feels right for you.
en.model: Example to adapt: My everyday experience has helped me practise safety and quality checks. I am interested in the Assembly Line Worker role because I enjoy helping people and taking responsibility. Add one real experience and your own reason for choosing this work.

en.text: How would you use safety in your day-to-day work?
en.hint: Give a practical example and two specific steps you would take.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would first understand what is needed, check the relevant guidance, and explain two practical next steps. I would check that the person understood and ask a colleague when unsure. This makes safety visible in my daily work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you were responsible for maintaining quality without skipping safety checks, or a similar task.
en.hint: Situation → Task → Action → Result. An example from home or school counts too.

en.text: As a Assembly Line Worker, how would you decide what to do first during a busy shift?
en.hint: Explain how you balance safety, urgency, and the people waiting for help.
en.model: Example to adapt: I would deal with any immediate safety issue first, then prioritise urgent tasks and people who are waiting. I would agree responsibilities with my teammate and explain any delay. I would still check accuracy before completing the work.

en.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you work it out?
en.hint: Show how you listened, found common ground, and reached a useful outcome.
en.model: Example to adapt: During a team task, we disagreed about priorities. I needed to help finish on time. I listened to my teammate, explained my concern, and suggested dividing the work. We agreed a plan and completed the task without delay. Use a real example from your life.

en.text: What would you do if you noticed a mistake involving teamwork?
en.hint: Talk through checking the facts, informing the right person, and correcting it.

en.text: Tell me about a time you used feedback to improve your work.
en.hint: Explain the feedback, what you changed, and how things improved.
